This record represents a written work on the theme of social equality and caste reform. The argument presented in this document proceeds from the premise that political democracy is incomplete without social democracy.

The text explores the relationship between liberty, equality and fraternity as interdependent values rather than separate ideals. It challenges the reader to examine whether formal legal equality is sufficient in the absence of social equality.

Verified content — pending rights clearance and archival authentication.
